### Observations (do not change the verdict)

- O2 (clamps homed in the baseline documents). Two clamps of the source's full assembly sit in the computation documents: "The waiver share never exceeds one" (`waiver_amount_by_household_income`; the source says "The scaled waiver share never exceeds one") and "never less than zero" (`countable_annual_income`). Under the baseline alone both are vacuous (share 0.5; non-negative sums), so they are the only trace in those documents that something else can move the figure; they name no modifier, give no pointer and list no exception, so they are not the "unless otherwise provided" kind of hint. Semantics are carried at the source's strength; neither clamp binds in this task (share 0.96; income 31,701.20).

## dependency_form

- Both prerequisite sentences stand verbatim in their blocked hubs, in state form, each with a same-form restatement naming only the record field (request status / annual household income on the request); neither is restated as an action, names a tool, policy or document, or appears in a second document.
- The depended-on hubs describe the waited-on states in the sentences' words ("so that the request carries its decision"; "the request under review carries the annual household income entered"). Both hops were marked state-derived in the blind answer; none pre-solved.
- The completion family mentions decision only as its own rule ("a request no longer awaiting decision is not completed"); the decision family never mentions the plan change; no route, checklist, ordered cross-problem procedure, contrast or cross-problem example exists.
- Titles/openings are general ("Completing the Household Income on a Waiver Request", "Recording Waiver Decisions on Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Console Reference", "Changing the Installment of a Current Plan — … Console Reference"); none mirrors the task.
- Factor documents state ladders as rules, name no other document or factor, and say nothing about which tier customers fall on; the baseline documents carry no modifier hint beyond observation O2.

**Verdict: PASS** (no KB-EXPLICIT RED).
